verdict.rationale: Drata's developer docs say it can 'automate compliance workflows with custom triggers and actions' and run automated evidence collection through custom integrations. Monitoring tests and monitoring docs point to continuous checks that run without manual intervention. The evidence is mostly marketing taglines and endpoint names, and nothing shows how a user configures autonomous or AI-driven background automations. Missing for 10: documented setup for trigger/action workflows, scheduling and background-execution details, agentic (AI-driven) autonomous automation rather than rule-based compliance checks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
